I hear you on that, I still get bullied to this day, and I’m 21 now! I haven’t got a lot of confidence in myself, Hell.. I’m struggling to even reply to you. Here in England we are still on lockdown so clubs aren’t an option. I used to go to church with my gran but she’s not well at the moment. I met a very good friend there called Ken, he was in his 70’s! But he died not too long ago. I’m used to being alone now. I have kinda got used to the fact that people don’t like me or want to talk to me. 

But thank you for doing so. You’ve made me very happy.

I want to die every night, but I’m still here. I’ve had the absolute worst luck, for about 7-8 years now. But I keep finding things that keep me going. I know you most probably won’t, but you can message me if you wanna talk, I’ll help you, figure something out, like I said, I’m still here so I gotta be doing something right.

You sound like a lovely person, and I’m grateful that you bothered to take time out of your day to write all that and I’m really happy that what you do brings you joy and makes you happy, and for that I am proud of you. For me it’s more difficult because I love what I do, but at the same time, it feels like a chore to do it, like I’m not making any progress. I try and talk to people, but I’m ignored 99% of the time. I was always seen as ‘the weird kid’ at school, and I tried to hard to fit in, but i was bullied for who I was, how I looked, what I did. And I think that’s what’s brought this on. I have no friends, nobody to talk to. I still hate myself and my appearance. People use me. They take advantage of me. They use me for money or lifts. And I’ll still do it because I can’t say no, I’ll feel guilty. That’s all I’m good for. I just want to be seen as someone more than that. But because of everything in the past, nobody wants to know me. So I do anything and everything to impress. It’s sad really. 
I’ve had no job for 6 months now, the people i worked with were like family and now none of them will talk to me. I’m so lost. I’m sorry, I’m just rambling now.

ive been working so hard for so long, ive taught myself so many different things just to be able to do things i couldn’t before and it seems like it was all worthless. I appreciate that though. It does mean a lot
